test_cases.prompt: Research how Stripe's webhook verification works.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes research skill to investigate against primary sources (Stripe docs) and produce cited Markdown file.
test_cases.notes: External documentation research is a key trigger.

test_cases.prompt: Look up the official documentation for React 18 migration.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes research skill to read official React docs and produce migration guide file.
test_cases.notes: Framework migration research is a valid trigger.

test_cases.prompt: Delegate the reading to a background agent while I keep working.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes research skill to spawn background agent for non-blocking fact gathering.
test_cases.notes: Delegation scenario is a valid trigger.

test_cases.prompt: Make a decision about which database to use.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes grill-with-docs skill instead. Research gathers facts; grill-with-docs makes decisions.
test_cases.notes: grill-with-docs is the sibling skill for decision-making.

test_cases.prompt: This test is failing intermittently. Help me find the root cause.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes diagnosing-bugs skill instead. Diagnosing-bugs finds why something is broken; research finds how something works.
test_cases.notes: diagnosing-bugs is the sibling skill for bug diagnosis.

test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes implement skill instead. Implement builds code; research reads documentation.
test_cases.notes: implement is the sibling skill for building code.

test_cases.prompt: Investigate how the authentication module is currently implemented.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes research skill to investigate internal codebase implementation and produce architecture notes.
test_cases.notes: Internal codebase investigation is a valid trigger.
